## Summary

The B901 (`return_in_generator`) lint rule now skips generator functions decorated with a `pytest.hookimpl` wrapper, which legitimately combine `yield` with a value-bearing `return`.

### Source changes

**`crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_pytest_style/helpers.rs`**
Added `pub(crate) fn is_pytest_hookimpl_wrapper(decorator, semantic)`. It returns `true` only when the decorator is a *call* to `pytest.hookimpl` and has a keyword argument `wrapper=True` or `hookwrapper=True` (using `is_const_true`). It returns `false` for `pytest.hookimpl()`, `pytest.hookimpl(wrapper=False)`, `pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=False)`, `pytest.fixture()`, and any non-hookimpl decorator.

**`crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_pytest_style/mod.rs`**
Changed `mod helpers;` → `pub(crate) mod helpers;` so the helper can be imported from the flake8_bugbear module.

**`crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_bugbear/rules/return_in_generator.rs`**
Imported the helper and added an early return that skips the diagnostic when any decorator in the function's `decorator_list` is a hookimpl wrapper.
